title: LLMObs canonical Span (v1alpha1)
$comment: Closed promoted set (02-span.md §1): any non-promoted attribute MUST live in 'attributes', hence additionalProperties:false. Generation fields are permitted on any kind per 02-span.md §3.3 (a span is generation_shaped iff it carries a generation field). x-llmobs-frozen marks frozen fields (05-update-semantics.md §5).

parent_span_id.description: In-trace parent; null for a trace-root span.

input.description: Opaque payload; MAY contain media tokens (02-span.md §4.3, §7).

input_content_type.description: MIME-style rendering hint for input; NOT queryable/promoted (02-span.md §4.3, F6).

output_content_type.description: Rendering hint for output; not promoted.

events.description: Span events (02-span.md §4.4); union-merged; present on all shapes; not promoted.

model.description: Generation field: the resolved/served model (e.g. gen_ai.response.model); requested model preserved under llmobs.raw.model_requested (02-span.md §5, F7).

provider.description: Generation field: model provider (openai, anthropic, bedrock, …); promoted (F7).

model_parameters.description: Generation field: request parameters as verbatim strings, keyed by name; not parsed at normalize time (F2).

completion_start_time.description: Generation field: time to first token.

prompt_ref.description: Optional prompt linkage as a reference, not a promoted column (02-span.md §5.4).

allOf.$comment: 06-usage-cost.md §4 step 1: provided cost short-circuits derivation, so pricing_snapshot_ref MUST be null/absent when cost_source is 'provided'.
